description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession's getLastDrmError method, specifically testing the behavior of retrieving the last DRM error in various scenarios. It defines a test class derived from MediaKeySessionTestBase and includes multiple test cases using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionGetLastDrmErrorTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing getLastDrmError functionality in MediaKeySession, derived from MediaKeySessionTestBase.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test that getLastDrmError successfully retrieves the last DRM error when the underlying session API returns OK.

methods.description: Test that getLastDrmError fails when the underlying session API indicates failure.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Test that getLastDrmError fails if an error occurs during the session's onError callback.
